note: Tenki Sandboxes / Runners / AI Code Reviewer are products of Tenki Cloud, LLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Luxor Technology Corporation (founded 2017; full-stack Bitcoin mining + AI compute company: mining pool, firmware, hardware, energy, plus AI hardware/compute/sandboxes/runners). Luxor describes itself as profitable and cash-flow positive with SOC 1/SOC 2 Type II attestations and audited financial statements, rather than as a VC-funded startup, so no funding round or ARR figure is publicly disclosed for either Luxor or the Tenki product line specifically.
